knowledge_base.title: Salon Services FAQ
knowledge_base.content:
Q: Do I need to book in advance?
A: We recommend booking at least 24 hours in advance, especially for weekends. Walk-ins are welcome based on availability.

Q: Can I request a specific stylist?
A: Absolutely! Let us know your preferred stylist when booking and we'll do our best to accommodate.

Q: How long does hair coloring take?
A: Single-process color takes about 2 hours. Highlights and balayage can take 2.5-3 hours depending on hair length.

Q: Do you have a cancellation policy?
A: We ask for at least 4 hours notice for cancellations. Late cancellations may be charged 50% of the service fee.

Q: Do you offer gift cards?
A: Yes! Gift cards are available in any denomination. They make perfect gifts for any occasion.
